definition_zh: 慈祥如伯叔的；长者般亲切的
definition_en: kind, genial, and protective in the manner of a good uncle
core_image: 从口袋里摸出糖来、眨眨眼的老伯伯
scene: 他拍拍少年的肩，笑纹里全是暖意。The old professor gave the student avuncular advice.
sceneCN: 这里 avuncular 指「长者般亲切的」（第 1 个义项：如好叔叔般慈爱）；句意：老教授像慈祥的长辈一样给学生建议。

pos.zh: 如伯叔般的；慈祥亲切的

derivatives.zh: 舅甥关系；叔侄特权（人类学术语，avuncul- + -ate）
伯父；叔父；舅父；姑父；姨父（同源基础词）

senses.title: Kindly like a good uncle
senses.definition: warm, genial, and kind in the way of a friendly uncle
senses.definitionCN: 如友善的叔叔般温暖、和蔼、亲切
senses.example: The coach's avuncular manner calmed the nervous freshmen.
senses.exampleCN: 教练慈祥的态度安抚了紧张的新生。
senses.why: The Latin root avunculus means little grandfather, the mother's brother: family warmth formalized.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 avunculus 意为「小祖父」，即舅父：家庭温情被正式命名。

senses.title: Protective toward the young
senses.definition: showing paternal-adjacent care for younger people without the father's authority
senses.definitionCN: 对晚辈施以父亲般却无父亲威严的照拂
senses.example: He took an avuncular interest in every intern.
senses.exampleCN: 他对每个实习生都像长辈一样上心。
senses.why: The uncle stands beside the father: care without the weight of command.
senses.whyCN: 伯叔站在父亲身旁：有照拂而无命令之重。

senses.title: Jovial and twinkling
senses.definition: of a manner, cheerful, twinkling, and slightly teasing
senses.definitionCN: 形容举止欢快、目光闪亮、略带打趣
senses.example: He delivered the reprimand with avuncular twinkle.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着长辈式的狡黠笑意说出批评。
senses.why: The good uncle teases as he guides; the word keeps the wink.
senses.whyCN: 好伯叔边引导边打趣，这个词里留着那个眼神。

senses.title: Relating to uncles literally
senses.definition: of or pertaining to an uncle, in literal or anthropological use
senses.definitionCN: 字面或人类学用法中，与伯叔舅相关
senses.example: Anthropologists mapped the avunculate across societies.
senses.exampleCN: 人类学家比较各社会的舅权制度。
senses.why: The literal root sense survives in academic vocabulary.
senses.whyCN: 字面词根义在学术词汇中得以存续。

senses.title: Benefactor-like generosity
senses.definition: generous in the giving, guiding way of a well-off relative
senses.definitionCN: 像宽裕亲戚那样慷慨解囊、指点提携
senses.example: An avuncular grant kept the small theater alive.
senses.exampleCN: 一笔长辈式的资助让小剧场维持了下去。
senses.why: The uncle traditionally funded the nephew's start.
senses.whyCN: 传统上，伯叔是侄甥起家的金主。

senses.title: Of statesmen and mentors
senses.definition: describing public figures who cultivate a wise, homely warmth
senses.definitionCN: 形容营造睿智亲和形象的公众人物
senses.example: The senator kept his avuncular style through three campaigns.
senses.exampleCN: 三次竞选，参议员始终保持着慈长辈的形象。
senses.why: Politics learned that a uncle's warmth disarms voters.
senses.whyCN: 政界发现，伯叔般的温暖能让选民卸下防备。

senses.title: Prescriptive but gentle
senses.definition: giving counsel that instructs without commanding
senses.definitionCN: 给予指导性却不下命令的忠告
senses.example: His avuncular editor trimmed the chapter with kindness.
senses.exampleCN: 慈长辈般的编辑温和地删改了那一章。
senses.why: Advice between authority and friendship is the uncle's register.
senses.whyCN: 介于权威与友谊之间的建议，正是伯叔的语域。

senses.title: Matrilineal kinship term
senses.definition: of the special status of the mother's brother in certain kinship systems
senses.definitionCN: 指某些亲属制度中舅父的特殊地位
senses.example: The avuncular bond outranked the paternal one in her clan.
senses.exampleCN: 在她的氏族里，舅甥之亲高于父子之亲。
senses.why: The Latin word meant exactly the mother's brother, and the technical sense honors that.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁原词正是指舅父，技术义正是对此的致敬。

intro.en: Avuncular comes from Latin avunculus, a mother's brother, a diminutive of avus, grandfather, so literally a little grandfather; English formed the adjective in the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: avuncular 出自拉丁语 avunculus「舅父」，是 avus「祖父」的小词，字面即「小祖父」；英语形容词形成于 19 世纪。

items.en: The kin-root is reconstructed as h₂ew-, the old word for grandfather or forefather.
items.cn: 亲属词根被重构为 h₂ew-，古老的「祖父、先祖」词。

items.en: avus meant grandfather; avunculus, its diminutive, meant specifically the mother's brother.
items.cn: avus 意为祖父；小词 avunculus 专指舅父。

items.en: Roman usage marked the mother's brother as the kindly relative, near the grandfather in standing.
items.cn: 罗马用法把舅父视为亲切的长辈，地位近于祖父。

items.en: The general uncle-word passed through Old French oncle into English uncle.
items.cn: 泛指的 uncle 一词经古法语 oncle 进入英语。

items.en: English coined avuncular as a learned adjective for uncle-like kindness.
items.cn: 英语在 19 世纪 20 至 30 年代造出 avuncular，指伯叔般的慈爱。

items.en: Anthropology later used avunculate for the mother's brother's special status.
items.cn: 人类学后来以 avunculate 指舅父的特殊地位。

note.en: Group one gathers the kin family and look-alikes; group two gathers words of kindly elders.
note.cn: 第一组收亲属词族及形近词；第二组收慈祥长者义场的词。

entries.definition: the everyday kin word, from the same Latin avunculus through Old French.
entries.definitionCN: 日常亲属词，同出拉丁语 avunculus，经古法语演变。

entries.definition: a hobby; begins with the same letters but comes from vocare, to call.
entries.definitionCN: 业余爱好；开头字母相同，词源为 vocare「呼唤」。

entries.definition: an open declaration; shares only the opening av-.
entries.definitionCN: 公开声明；仅开头 av- 相同。

entries.definition: fatherly; warmer word for authority plus care.
in the manner of a trusted guide.
brusque in manner; the stern uncle against the avuncular one.
entries.definitionCN: 生硬粗率；与慈祥伯叔相对的另一类长辈。

normalIntro.en: Bury uncle inside avuncular: the av is the grandfather, the uncul is little.
normalIntro.cn: 在 avuncular 里埋着 uncle：av 是祖父，uncul 是「小」。

normal.en: avunculus means little grandfather: the mother's brother.
normal.cn: avunculus 意为「小祖父」：即舅父。

normal.en: The stress pattern av-UN-cular hides the word uncle.
normal.cn: 重音 av-UN-cular 中藏着 uncle 一词。

normal.en: avuncular advice is the set phrase of the word.
normal.cn: avuncular advice 是这个词的固定搭配。

normal.en: Anthropology's avunculate names the mother's brother's status.
normal.cn: 人类学术语 avunculate 指舅权地位。

normal.en: It is a learned 19th-century coinage: sprinkle, do not pour.
normal.cn: 它是 19 世纪的书面造词：宜点缀，勿滥用。

abstract.en: Feel a heavy hand land gently on one shoulder.
abstract.cn: 感觉一只大手轻轻落在肩上。

abstract.en: Avuncular is the smell of pipe smoke and good stories.
abstract.cn: avuncular 是烟斗与好故事的气味。

abstract.en: See the pocket that always seems to hold sweets.
abstract.cn: 看那个总像揣着糖果的口袋。

examples.en: The senior partner offered avuncular counsel over coffee.
examples.cn: 资深合伙人边喝咖啡边给出长辈式的忠告。

examples.en: His avuncular chuckle carried through the courtroom.
examples.cn: 他慈长辈般的轻笑传遍了法庭。

examples.en: Anthropologists studied the avuncular duties of the mother's brother.
examples.cn: 人类学家研究舅父承担的舅权义务。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱我足球俱乐部」——老伯伯爱我，带我去看足球俱乐部，像亲叔一样

root: 出自拉丁语 avunculus「舅父」，为 avus「祖父」的指小词，字面义「小祖父」；经英语 19 世纪的书面造词成为形容词。词根 h₂ew- 属印欧语「祖父」一系；与 uncle 同源而分工：uncle 表亲属本身，avuncular 表其神态。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the genial uncle manner outward: protection of the young, the twinkling humor, the literal kinship senses, and the public figures who borrow the style.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义项从慈叔神态向外延展：护佑晚辈、含笑的幽默、字面亲属义，以及借用这一形象的公众人物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an elder's hand on a young shoulder, half guide, half co-conspirator.
core.cn: 核心意象：长辈的手落在晚辈肩上，半是引路，半是同谋。

branches.en: THE MANNER SIDE: genial warmth with a twinkle.
THE CARE SIDE: protecting and funding the young.
branches.cn: 照拂一面：护佑与资助晚辈。

branches.en: THE KINSHIP SIDE: the literal uncle and the mother's brother's status.
branches.cn: 亲属一面：字面伯叔与舅权地位。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC SIDE: statesmen wearing uncle-like warmth.
branches.cn: 公众一面：披着慈叔外衣的政要。

branches.en: THE COUNSEL SIDE: instruction without command.
branches.cn: 忠告一面：指导而不命令。

intro.en: Avuncular is avunculus plus the adjective ending -ar, a learned Latin formation.
intro.cn: avuncular 即 avunculus 加形容词词尾 -ar，属书面拉丁构词。

latinIntro.en: Latin built kinship adjectives in -aris, as in paternal and maternal from pater and mater.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语以 -aris 构造亲属形容词，如 pater、mater 造出 paternal、maternal。

items.exampleCN: 罗马家族称谓中的 avus
